purpose: Three static 2D animation art-style variants retaining the current app's home layout, isometric room and color families. No app implementation changes.

displayedOrder.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / ui-mockup.
Create a production-quality static UI mockup by EDITING the attached CURRENT APP SCREENSHOT. The user wants three stylistic variants of this exact existing app. This call must produce only ONE independent finished mobile home screen.
Target 786 x 1572 px, 1:2 portrait aspect ratio, sharp high-resolution. App content only, no phone body, device bezel, notch, OS status bar, clock/battery indicators, browser chrome, presentation title, option number, comparison grid or extra screens.
The attached screenshot is the exact edit target. Preserve the ENTIRE UI layout and the same room camera, silhouette, scene bounds, object positions and relative scale. Preserve the current warm color families, cream whitespace, navy typography, violet secondary text, pale yellow selection and green selected-tab label. Change only the drawing treatment of the central room, red panda and three illustrated navigation icons. This is an asset-style exploration within the CURRENT DESIGN, not a new layout or new setting.
Keep the isometric cutaway room at the same scale in its current slot: plant-covered bookshelves on the left wall, window and framed botanical pictures on the right wall, warm orange wooden desk at center, large green plant on right, blue patterned rug on front-left floor, teal cushion front-right, floorboards. Keep the SAME small orange red panda in the same position behind the desk, writing in an open book. Preserve its face shape and original big round brown eyes with white sclera/highlights, white eyebrows and cheeks, orange ears, striped tail, green overalls. Do not substitute dot eyes, radically change facial proportions or enlarge the character.
ALL UI text and geometry must remain unchanged from reference:
Top left large navy "나의 책상"; mute icon, sun icon and "낮" upper right.
Violet subtitle "오늘도 같이 시작해요".
Below room: "오늘의 집중 · 0분" with bold navy 0분.
Side-notched ticket selectors: pale yellow selected "25분" and check; white "50분".
Shuffle icon and "랫서팬더가 골라주기".
White outlined rounded button "집중 시작", navy play circle right, navy lower edge.
Bottom menu icons: desk/book/lamp, checked calendar, golden gear. Labels "책상", "기록", "설정". Same positions, sizes and selected pale yellow backdrop.
Maintain readable accurate Korean typography and generous spacing. All controls fully visible. No added features, cards, rewards, extra animals, extra words, balloons or decoration. Retain existing screen proportions faithfully; do not rearrange content. Current date anchor 2026-10-08; add no dates.

Art direction (internal name only): 깔끔한 셀 애니메이션.
Transform the room and character into impeccably clean traditional 2D CEL ANIMATION artwork: smooth fine uniform dark-brown ink contours, large solid local color areas, exactly one clean hard-edged shade shape per material where necessary. Eliminate all fur texture, paper grain, painterly strokes, woodgrain and glossy volume. No 3D render, gradients, airbrush or ambient occlusion. Keep precise original furniture proportions and original color richness. Orange wood, warm cream walls, saturated natural green foliage and vibrant red panda. Simplify tiny leaf veins and rug details just enough to animate cleanly. Preserve the isometric geometry as a flat drawn background. Outline weights should be refined, NOT thick sticker outlines. Character's expression stays exactly the same gentle attentive expression. All three navigation illustrations must use this same clean thin-ink cel style. The whole result should feel crisp, calm and as close as possible to the current app, with noticeably cleaner and flatter illustration rendering.

Art direction (internal name only): 부드러운 손그림 애니메이션.
Re-ink all illustration assets as soft hand-drawn traditional 2D animation background and character cels. The difference must be clearly visible: delicate slightly irregular WARM COCOA/BROWN pencil-like outlines instead of sharp black/navy contours, rounder botanical shapes, muted warm honey/ochre wood and sage/olive leaves within the EXISTING original palette. UI typography and UI controls MUST retain their original colors unchanged; apply this softer color treatment to artwork only. Flat matte color fills, very subtle sparse dry-brush edge variation, warm cream light areas; no heavy grain, no modeled realistic shadows, no gradients, no glossy volume. Retain each object and its existing dimensions, same isometric camera and exact room boundaries. Simplify repetitive fine linework and hard wood details while keeping books, wall prints, window, plant arrangements and rug clearly recognizable. The room should feel quieter and airier, like an original hand-inked 2D animated short film. Keep the red panda's existing facial proportions, brown eyes with white sclera and highlights, scale and writing pose; give it soft warm russet orange flat fur and gentle cocoa contours rather than texture. Retain enough dark line contrast to keep the character crisp. Draw the desk/calendar/gear navigation icons in the same soft matte hand-drawn animation style at their unchanged sizes. A cozy modestly desaturated pastel art layer within the exact current UI, never a new layout or grayscale illustration.

Art direction (internal name only): 굵은 윤곽선의 카툰.
Redraw the entire room illustration, red panda and bottom navigation icon illustrations as BOLD GRAPHIC FLAT 2D TELEVISION CARTOON art. This must be unmistakably different in line weight and simplification from the original textured art: confident thick smooth DARK COCOA outlines around every major object, chunky simplified silhouettes, very sparse inner lines, entirely solid matte color fills, playful rounded contours. Outer contours roughly twice the weight of interior lines, strongly readable at small screen size. Zero paper texture, zero fuzzy fur texture, zero wood grain, zero realistic modeling, zero gradients, zero ambient occlusion. Use base color plus at most one flat hard-edged shadow color. Keep original orange/honey wood, cream walls, leafy greens, indigo books/rug, teal cushion and red panda orange colors, just cleaner graphic color blocks. No monochrome and no new palette. Preserve EXACT isometric camera geometry, original room footprint and all object placements. Drawing may simplify a cluster of tiny leaves into larger clear leaf groups within its original footprint, and make floorboards and rug pattern more graphic. Keep the red panda at the same small scale and retain original large open brown eyes with white sclera and highlights, white facial markings, green outfit and attentive writing pose. Do not create a chibi enlargement, dot eyes or change expression. The character and furniture should look easy to animate as 2D cels with clean separate painted shapes. The three navigation drawings must match the thick-lined, flatter graphic art. UI headings, text, button outlines, backgrounds, layouts and copy remain exactly the original reference; do NOT thicken or restyle the UI typography or ticket/CTA controls. Strong visible cartoon rendering transformation limited to existing illustration assets.
